name: Minnesota Cube Melt 2015

venue.name: [First Free Evangelical Church](http://firstfreechurch.org/) & [Augsburg Park Library](http://www.hclib.org/about/locations/augsburg-park)
venue.address: 5150 Chicago Avenue South Minneapolis, MN, 55417 & 7100 Nicollet Ave. Richfield, MN 55423
venue.details: On the bottom floor of the church, enter through side door facing east and go downstairs.

information: If you pay the fees online, the cost will be $10 for the first event, and $2 for each additional event If you pay the day of the competition, the cost is $10 for the first event, and $4 for each additional event (cap of $24). (FMC willl be free) The fees go towards the cost of running the competition, prizes, etc. Any funds beyond that go towards future competitions. If you register with a CubingUSA account, you can pay the fees at anytime before the registration deadline.
